array.string: cd ~/Desktop/tennis-around-the-world && /usr/local/bin/node scripts/fetch-data.js >> data/update.log 2>&1 && /usr/local/bin/node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/players_final.json','utf-8'));const m={};for(const p of d.players||[]){const c=p.nameCn||'';if(!c)continue;if(p.displayName)m[p.displayName.toUpperCase()]=c;if(p.firstName&&p.lastName){m[(p.lastName+' '+p.firstName).toUpperCase()]=c;m[p.lastName.toUpperCase()+' '+p.firstName]=c;}}fs.writeFileSync('data/player_name_cn.json',JSON.stringify(m,null,2));"
